lines.text: Welcome back to Bot Kitchen! Today: a quote bot for landscapers. In twenty seconds!
First, a web form. Add a pinch of photo upload. Then fold in the questions: yard size, the job, and when.
Pop it in the oven and... ding! The quote request lands in your inbox, sorted and ready.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Know a business owner buried in quote requests? Send them this. You're still the captain.
